_note: W1-a (2026-11-07), see mesen2-results/W1-a_20261107.md. The player-movement notes say that no code sets $AA bits $0800 / $0400 ('$AB bits 2/3') and that nothing reads $AB bits 2 / 3. Measured: TSB $AB with #$04 / #$08 ran 309 times over 14 sessions (scenes $01, $15, $2E, $3E, $3F, $5B, $72, $DD, $E8) and in the 277 probed setter ticks (8 sessions) the $AA word showed bit $0400 / $0800 at the vertical gates; the gates (BIT #$0800 at 184352, BIT #$0400 at 184364) read them. In 276 of the 277 probed setter ticks the vertical velocity $24 is 0 after the pop, so neither gate is reached; the one tick that reached the north gate had bit $0400 set. Bit 7 is set (407 times) and no instruction tests it. Dry-run only: npm run merge -- plans/extracted-audit/mesen2-results/specs/W1-a_notes.json --dry-run.

edit.find: $0800 and $0400 are tested before the north and south dispatch, but nothing in extracted/ ever sets them; player_move_west only clears them (TRB #$0840 / #$0440). Those two gates therefore always pass.
edit.with: $0800 and $0400 are tested before the north and south dispatch. They are bits 3 and 2 of $AB: the wall-slide variant entries set them with TSB $AB (player_move_west code_02DCCB and code_02DC77, player_move_east EastWallSouthFlag and EastWallNorthFlag), and the horizontal-speed-smaller paths of player_move_west clear them (TRB #$0840 / #$0440). A set bit makes the matching gate skip that vertical dispatch for the tick. In the measured runs the setter ticks have $24 = 0 after the pop (the vertical phase is skipped anyway), so the gates never saw their own bit set.
